# Fidelity Funding

> Business funding broker (Staten Island, NY) connecting US small businesses with funding partners: small business loans, merchant cash advances, working capital. Card processing via PayPilot by MCCPS (https://mccp.services).

## Key pages
- [Apply](https://fidelity2.joe-miz.com/apply/)
- [Funding calculator](https://fidelity2.joe-miz.com/tools/funding-calculator/)
- [Compare offers](https://fidelity2.joe-miz.com/tools/compare-offers/)
- [Glossary](https://fidelity2.joe-miz.com/glossary/)
- [Contact](https://fidelity2.joe-miz.com/contact/)

## Funding Options
- [Merchant Cash Advance](https://fidelity2.joe-miz.com/funding/merchant-cash-advance/): Learn how a merchant cash advance works: factor rates, holdback percentages, daily remittance, and which businesses an MCA fits. Plain-English guide.
- [Working Capital Loans for Small Businesses](https://fidelity2.joe-miz.com/funding/working-capital-loans/): Working capital loans bridge the gap between bills and customer payments. See how they compare with MCAs and lines of credit, and what lenders review.
- [Small Business Loans: Types, Terms and Qualifying](https://fidelity2.joe-miz.com/funding/small-business-loans/): Compare small business loan structures, repayment terms and what underwriters review, from revenue and credit to time in business and collateral.
- [Short-Term Business Loans: 3 to 24 Month Funding](https://fidelity2.joe-miz.com/funding/short-term-business-loans/): Short-term business loans typically run 3 to 24 months with daily or weekly payments. See how they work, what they cost, and when they make sense.
- [Business Line of Credit: Revolving Funding Explained](https://fidelity2.joe-miz.com/funding/business-line-of-credit/): A business line of credit lets you draw what you need and pay interest only on what you use. Learn draws, repayment, fees and who qualifies.
- [Equipment Financing: Loans, Leases and How They Work](https://fidelity2.joe-miz.com/funding/equipment-financing/): Equipment financing uses the machine itself as collateral. Compare loans and leases, see a worked payment example, and learn what to prepare before applying.
- [Invoice Factoring: Turn Unpaid Invoices into Cash](https://fidelity2.joe-miz.com/funding/invoice-factoring/): Invoice factoring sells your unpaid invoices for fast cash. See how advance rates, fees and recourse versus non-recourse work, with a worked example.
- [Revenue-Based Financing: Payments That Flex With Sales](https://fidelity2.joe-miz.com/funding/revenue-based-financing/): Revenue-based financing ties repayment to a share of monthly revenue. Learn how it works, how it compares with an MCA, and when it fits your business.
- [SBA Loans Explained: 7(a), 504 and Timelines](https://fidelity2.joe-miz.com/funding/sba-loans/): SBA loans offer long terms and competitive pricing but move slowly. Learn the 7(a) and 504 programs, typical timelines, and when a faster bridge makes sense.
- [Business Funding with Bad Credit: What Is Realistic](https://fidelity2.joe-miz.com/funding/bad-credit-business-loans/): Bad credit does not always close the door on business funding. See how revenue-first underwriting works, realistic expectations, costs and how to improve.
- [Startup Business Funding: What Is Realistic Early On](https://fidelity2.joe-miz.com/funding/startup-business-funding/): Funding a business under a year old is different. See what funders look for, realistic options at 6 to 12 months, and what to avoid in early-stage borrowing.
- [Same-Day Business Funding: What Makes Speed Possible](https://fidelity2.joe-miz.com/funding/same-day-business-funding/): Can business funding really arrive the same day? See what makes speed possible, which documents to have ready, and the trade-offs of getting cash fast.
- [Inventory Financing: Stock Up Without Draining Cash](https://fidelity2.joe-miz.com/funding/inventory-financing/): Inventory financing helps you buy stock ahead of demand. Compare inventory-backed and unsecured options, with a worked turnover example and key risks.
- [Payroll Funding: Bridging Gaps Without Getting Burned](https://fidelity2.joe-miz.com/funding/payroll-funding/): Payroll funding bridges the gap between payday and customer payments. Learn the options, a worked cost example, and how to borrow without a debt spiral.
- [Seasonal Business Funding](https://fidelity2.joe-miz.com/funding/seasonal-business-funding/): Seasonal business funding explained: how to cover pre-season costs, match payments to your revenue cycle, and avoid repaying during your slow months.
- [Business Expansion Loans](https://fidelity2.joe-miz.com/funding/business-expansion-loans/): Business expansion loans can fund a second location, build-out, or new equipment. Learn how to plan ROI, size the request and choose the right structure.
- [MCA Consolidation: When It Helps and When It Hurts](https://fidelity2.joe-miz.com/funding/mca-consolidation/): MCA consolidation combines multiple merchant cash advances into one payment. Learn when it eases cash flow, when it adds cost, and what to check first.
- [Purchase Order Financing](https://fidelity2.joe-miz.com/funding/purchase-order-financing/): Purchase order financing helps you pay suppliers for confirmed customer orders. See how it works, what it costs, and when it beats other options.
- [Business Term Loans](https://fidelity2.joe-miz.com/funding/business-term-loans/): Business term loans offer a lump sum repaid on a fixed schedule over a longer horizon. See how they work, what they cost and how to qualify.
- [Unsecured Business Loans](https://fidelity2.joe-miz.com/funding/unsecured-business-loans/): Unsecured business loans don't require specific collateral, but personal guarantees and liens still apply. Learn what that means and how to qualify.
- [Business Cash Advance vs. Loan: Which Fits You?](https://fidelity2.joe-miz.com/funding/business-cash-advance-vs-loan/): Business cash advance vs loan: compare cost, repayment, speed, qualification and risk side by side, with a simple framework to decide which fits you.
- [Fast Business Loans: Speed vs. Cost](https://fidelity2.joe-miz.com/funding/fast-business-loans/): Need business funding fast? Learn what speeds up approval, the real cost of speed, and how to prepare so you can move quickly without overpaying.
- [Low-Documentation Business Funding](https://fidelity2.joe-miz.com/funding/low-doc-business-loans/): Low-documentation business funding relies on bank statements instead of tax returns and financials. Learn how it works, what it costs and who it suits.
- [Commercial Vehicle Financing: Trucks, Vans and Trailers](https://fidelity2.joe-miz.com/funding/commercial-vehicle-financing/): Understand commercial vehicle financing for trucks, vans and trailers: loan vs lease, down payments, new vs used, and what funding partners review.
- [Restaurant Equipment Financing: Kitchen Gear, Hoods and POS](https://fidelity2.joe-miz.com/funding/restaurant-equipment-financing/): Restaurant equipment financing for ranges, walk-ins, hoods and POS systems: how it works, new vs used, and how to match payments to restaurant cash flow.
- [Medical Equipment Financing: Imaging, Chairs and Lasers](https://fidelity2.joe-miz.com/funding/medical-equipment-financing/): Medical equipment financing for imaging, dental chairs, lasers and more: how it works, how to project ROI, and what funding partners review.
- [Construction Equipment Financing: Excavators, Skid Steers and More](https://fidelity2.joe-miz.com/funding/construction-equipment-financing/): Construction equipment financing for excavators, skid steers and loaders: new vs used, loan vs rent, and how to size payments to project cash flow.
- [Emergency Business Funding: What to Do When Cash Runs Short](https://fidelity2.joe-miz.com/funding/emergency-business-funding/): Emergency business funding for sudden repairs, lost revenue or unexpected bills: fast options, trade-offs, and how to avoid panic decisions.
- [Business Funding for Women Entrepreneurs](https://fidelity2.joe-miz.com/funding/business-funding-for-women/): Funding options for women entrepreneurs: grants vs financing, free SBA resources, SCORE and SBDC help, and how to prepare an application that stands out.
- [Funding for Minority-Owned Businesses](https://fidelity2.joe-miz.com/funding/minority-business-funding/): Funding paths for minority-owned businesses: CDFIs, SBA resources, SBDC support, certifications and private financing, with realistic expectations.

## Blog
- [What Is a Factor Rate? MCA Pricing Explained](https://fidelity2.joe-miz.com/blog/factor-rate-explained/): A factor rate is a fixed multiplier that sets what you repay on a merchant cash advance. Learn to calculate total payback and why it is not an APR.
- [Total Payback vs. APR: Comparing Funding Offers](https://fidelity2.joe-miz.com/blog/total-payback-vs-apr/): APR, factor rates and flat fees do not line up on their own. Learn a step-by-step method to compare business funding offers by total payback and real cost.
- [How MCA Holdback Percentages Work](https://fidelity2.joe-miz.com/blog/how-mca-holdback-works/): The holdback percentage decides how much of your sales goes toward a merchant cash advance. See how split remittance and fixed ACH debits differ in practice.
- [Daily vs. Weekly Payments: Which Is Better?](https://fidelity2.joe-miz.com/blog/daily-vs-weekly-payments/): Daily and weekly repayment feel very different for cash flow. Compare both schedules, see worked examples and learn which suits your deposit pattern best.
- [What Underwriters Look For in Your Bank Statements](https://fidelity2.joe-miz.com/blog/bank-statements-underwriters-review/): Underwriters read your bank statements for deposits, balances, NSFs and other funders. See what they check and how to tidy your statements before applying.
- [NSFs and Negative Days: Why They Matter](https://fidelity2.joe-miz.com/blog/nsf-and-negative-days/): NSF fees and negative-balance days are red flags on business bank statements. Learn why funders care and how to fix the pattern before you apply.
- [The Real Risks of MCA Stacking](https://fidelity2.joe-miz.com/blog/mca-stacking-risks/): Stacking multiple merchant cash advances can bury your cash flow in payments. Learn how positions pile up, the warning signs and safer ways out.
